title: Art Nouveau — An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Night-garden plate grows
scenes.purpose: A single seed-idea sprouts vines that bloom into nodes and are joined by one tendril, forming a connected system inside an Art Nouveau frame.
visuals: Deep ink-green ground with stationary procedural grain
Double rounded frame drawn from top centre
Mirrored whiplash borders with sprouting leaves
Translucent green nimbus behind a terracotta seed
Five vines with path-attached leaves ending in six-petal blooms
Terracotta tendril ring linking all blooms
Cream serif lettering revealed along its arc and baseline

beats.development: Frame and whiplash borders begin drawing; nimbus irises open and the seed swells with its germ line drawing.
Vines reach their nodes with leaves unfurling as each tip passes; title writes along its arc; blooms start opening.
All blooms are open; one tendril ring draws outward from the top bloom in both directions, linking every node; caption is revealed left to right.

findings: Growth is sequenced seed → vines → blooms → ring, so attention moves outward from the centre.
Composition settles by about 2.15 s, before the 2.7 s limit.
justifiedHolds: 2.2–3.0 s: full-plate reading hold for both lines of copy.

notes: No source-frame matches and no preview recipes were supplied; the dark ground is a scene-dependent alternative, not source evidence.
